content: Wacom on macOS: Chrome reports tiltY correctly while Firefox macOS inverts it (Bugzilla 1822714); Chrome M58 added tangentialPressure/twist on Mac tested on Intuos4/Cintiq21; Electron issue 7815 documented Wacom clicks/scroll not registering on macOS with no root cause; Wacom support notes pressure loss from driver settings, security-permission setup on macOS, and per-application pressure toggles. Palm rejection is not provided by Chromium; it is a driver/hardware concern.
